heads.en: The LINE blast! The message is silent, the call is silent, the Internet is handing out self-help, and the communication software, LINE, is coming out again! In recent times, many netizens have called for help on social platforms, and the phone version of LINE has suddenly not jumped out of a message alert, and the voice is silent and often missing. At present, there is no official explanation for the anomalies, but there are also netizens who have found out why, as long as the configuration of the computer version of LINE is adjusted, it can be resolved.
